tool.name: load_src_report_source
tool.description:
Read the original file-backed `/src` vulnerability report from the host side when execution hits ambiguity or missing detail.
Use this only as an on-demand fallback during reproduction, not as the default planning input. If the current `/src` task came from inline text, this tool will report that no file-backed source is available.

parameter.name: source_label
parameter.description: The original `/src` source label. For file-backed reports this is the absolute report path provided by the host.

parameter.name: max_chars
parameter.description: Maximum number of characters to return from the original report. Defaults to 12000.

returns.description: Response containing: success, message, source_path, source_dir, source_name, content, truncated, total_chars, and returned_chars.

tool.name: save_src_repro_bundle
tool.description:
Persist a `/src` reproduction bundle into the current Strix run directory.
Use this after analyzer/planner/reproducer stages complete, or after `/src` precheck stops early. The bundle is stored under `strix_runs/<run_name>/src_repro/<bundle_id>/` with source report, analysis, plan, execution trace, final verdict, and manifest.

parameter.name: source_report
parameter.description: The original plain-text vulnerability report used for `/src` reproduction.

parameter.name: analysis_json
parameter.description: Analyzer output as JSON string when available. If plain text is provided, the tool will store a normalized form.

parameter.name: reproduction_plan
parameter.description: Structured planner output for the reproduction steps.

parameter.name: execution_trace
parameter.description: Reproducer execution notes or full execution report.

parameter.name: final_verdict
parameter.description: Final `/src` conclusion text that should be written to `04_final_verdict.md`.

parameter.name: source_label
parameter.description: Input source label such as `inline` or the referenced report file path.

parameter.name: bundle_id
parameter.description: Optional deterministic bundle ID. If omitted, a new bundle ID is generated automatically.

returns.description: Response containing: success, message, bundle_id, output_dir, files, and manifest.

function.parameter: ## Detailed Reproduction Steps 1. Open the page
